summary.text: One of the twenty-three suitors from Same on Cephallenia in Apollodorus' catalogue — a namesake of Eumelus son of Admetus, the charioteer of Pherae in the Iliad.

story.text: Apollodorus names Eumelus among the wooers who came from Same, listed after Lycaethus and before Itanus in Epitome 7.28.
Homer's Iliad knows another Eumelus — son of Admetus and Alcestis, lord of Pherae and a famed charioteer at Troy — not this Cephallenian wooer.
